paper.title: Verify the Verifier: Specification-Grounded LLM Cross-Checking for Bugs That Escape UVM Scoreboards
paper.title_source: citation_title meta of the saved abstract page

licence_line: paper arXiv nonexclusive-distrib 1.0; method only; no upstream repository exists; clean-room stdlib code
model_role: the paper's model-based cross-check is stood in for by a rule-based clause evaluator (clause_audit); no model is called
fixture: fixtures/main.json (fixture-authored toy 4-entry FIFO, five spec clauses, five design models, seven planted cases)

measured.note: planted counts on a fixture-authored fixture; not model or real-world rates

mutants.rule: a timed-out mutant is reported TIMEOUT and is not counted as killed

on_unmeasured.why: Author-reported on the abstract page; not reproduced here and not comparable with the planted counts.

claims.what: 564 bugs inserted into four OpenTitan IPs
68 of them are candidate scoreboard escapes (non-equivalent, exercised by the tests, yet passing)
41 confirmed as scoreboard escapes, with assertions failing on the buggy design and proven on the original
